changes.title: Keep Android Back on its registered route
changes.text: Unregister libGDX's competing predictive-Back callback before registering APD's callback, and prevent replacement input handlers from reclaiming it. This corrects the Android14 compatibility failure found in the preceding candidate while preserving delayed-duplicate protection, normal navigation and legacy platforms.
